source_system: arXiv:2512.19484 abstract and AIAC news17 field catalog

families.paper_title: Structured Event Representation and Stock Return Predictability
families.economic_mechanism: The paper extracts structured news-event features with an LLM and attention model for cross-sectional return prediction. Test whether vendor event sentiment gains information when conditioned on entity/event relevance, recurrence timing, event density, or event-specific classifiers.
families.expected_direction: No direction or return improvement is assumed for these Fast Expression proxies; compare each interaction against a sentiment-only control under matched settings.
falsification_conditions: The structured proxy does not outperform the matched sentiment-only control.
The sign or quality is unstable across adjacent windows and event-coverage strata.
WQ quality gates fail under the same Delay 1 News configuration.
families.mapping_limitations: The paper's LLM-extracted event structure and attention model are unavailable in AIAC Fast Expression. These eleven vendor news17 D1 fields are exploratory proxies, not a reproduction or paper-validated Alpha.
families.migration_note: Keep all inputs inside news17 Delay 1 and the task's allowed field list. Do not infer PASS from the paper or from a proxy backtest.
